tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Find projects by name, status, type, or date range. Returns id, name, status, progress, dates, managers. Filterable fields: name, statusLabel, customTypeLabel, startDate, endDate.

dateFrom.description: Filter projects starting on or after this date (ISO 8601)

dateTo.description: Filter projects ending on or before this date (ISO 8601)

sort.description: Sort field (default: "name"). Use DataMart field names.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get project details by ID with subcomponent counts. Budget can be included via include: ["budget"]. For tasks, risks, issues, purchases, and revenues use the dedicated tools: list_project_tasks, get_project_risks, get_project_issues, get_project_purchases, get_project_revenues.

include.description: Optional data to include. Only "budget" is supported. Subcomponent arrays (tasks, risks, etc.) are accessed via dedicated tools.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find services by name, status, type, or date range. Same query shape as search_projects but for services.

dateFrom.description: Filter services starting on or after this date (ISO 8601)

dateTo.description: Filter services ending on or before this date (ISO 8601)

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get service details by ID with subcomponent counts. Budget can be included via include: ["budget"]. For activities, purchases, and revenues use the dedicated tools: list_service_activities, get_service_purchases, get_service_revenues.

include.description: Optional data to include. Only "budget" is supported. Subcomponent arrays (activities, etc.) are accessed via dedicated tools.

tools.name: list_service_activities
tools.description: List activities for a service with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of activities to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_service_purchases
tools.description: Get purchase orders for a service with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of purchases to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_service_revenues
tools.description: Get revenue items for a service with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

limit.description: Max revenue items to return (default 50, max 200)

skip.description: Number of revenue items to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: list_project_tasks
tools.description: List tasks for a project with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of tasks to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_project_budget
tools.description: Get budget summary for a project. Returns four budget objects: budgetTopDown (planned), budgetBottomUp (estimated), budgetPeriodEndClose (forecast), budgetActual (spent).

tools.name: get_project_purchases
tools.description: Get purchase orders for a project with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of purchases to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_project_revenues
tools.description: Get revenue items for a project with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

limit.description: Max revenue items to return (default 50, max 200)

skip.description: Number of revenue items to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_project_risks
tools.description: Get risks for a project with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of risks to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: get_project_issues
tools.description: Get issues for a project with pagination. Returns { items, total, limit, skip, hasMore }. Default limit: 50, max: 200.

skip.description: Number of issues to skip (for pagination)

tools.name: list_task_progress
tools.description: List the progress (seguimiento/follow-up) history for a task, newest first. Each entry contains TaskFollowUpId, Percentage, AssessmentId, ShortDescription, Description, ReportDate, CreatedBy, IsCompleted. Task progress is a time-series of entries, not a single field on the task; this is why update_task rejects PercentComplete.

projectId.description: The project ID containing the task

taskId.description: The task ID to list progress entries for

tools.name: get_project_progress
tools.description: Get the project progress report: the expected progress curve (from task dates and working days), the baseline expected curve, and the historical follow-up entries (date + percentage). Useful to compare planned vs actual progress.

projectId.description: The project ID to get the progress report for

tools.name: create_task_progress
tools.description: Report progress on a task by creating a new progress (seguimiento/follow-up) entry. This is the correct way to set a task's completion percentage: it triggers task status transitions (100% completes the task, dropping below 100% reopens it), parent task rollups, automatic project progress, events, and notifications. Use get_reference_data with entity "assessments" to discover valid assessmentId values. Returns the created entry read back from v2 REST.

projectId.description: The project ID containing the task

taskId.description: The task ID to report progress on

assessmentId.description: Assessment rating ID (required). Discover valid values with get_reference_data entity "assessments"

tools.name: update_task_progress
tools.description: Update an existing task progress (seguimiento/follow-up) entry via PATCH. Only send the fields you want to change. Use list_task_progress to find the progressId. Returns the updated entry read back from v2 REST.

projectId.description: The project ID containing the task

taskId.description: The task ID the progress entry belongs to

progressId.description: The progress entry ID to update (TaskFollowUpId from list_task_progress)

tools.name: aggregate_portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio-level analytics: group projects by any field and compute metrics (count, avgProgress, totalBudget, totalActual). Uses DataMart aggregation -- no REST equivalent. Available groupBy fields: statusLabel, priorityLabel, methodology, customTypeLabel, isClosed, managers.name.

filter.description: Additional MongoDB filter to narrow the portfolio (merged with componentType: project)

tools.name: query_datamart
tools.description:
Run a custom query against ITM DataMart (MongoDB-backed). For advanced analysis beyond typed tools.

Operations:
- "components": list with filters. Params: where, project, sort, limit (max 200), skip
- "component": single by ID. Params: id, project
- "aggregateComponents": aggregation pipeline. Params: pipeline (must end with $limit, max 1000)

Allowed filter operators: $eq, $ne, $in, $nin, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $regex, $options, $exists, $not, $and, $or, $nor
Allowed pipeline stages: $match, $project, $group, $sort, $limit, $skip, $unwind, $addFields, $set, $unset
Banned: $lookup, $merge, $out, $function, $accumulator, $where, $facet

Key fields: id, name, code, componentType, statusLabel, priorityLabel, percentComplete, startDate, endDate, methodology, managers, budgetTopDown, budgetActual.

Important: Projecting full embedded arrays (tasks: 1, risks: 1, issues: 1, purchases: 1, revenues: 1, activities: 1) is rejected because they can be too large. Use dot notation (e.g. "tasks.name": 1) or the dedicated subcomponent tools with limit/skip.

limit.description: Max results (default 50, max 200 for list, 1000 for agg)

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Find team members by name or email. Returns userId, name, email, role. Uses v2 REST API (not DataMart).

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get details for a single user by ID. Returns full user profile including roles, categories, and contact info.

tools.name: get_reference_data
tools.description: Get reference data lists (statuses, types, priorities, risk impact/probability, assessments) for any entity. Useful for understanding valid values when filtering or interpreting data. Available entities: projectstatuses, gettaskstatuses, gettasktypes, gettaskpriorities, getprojecttypes, projectpriorities, riskstatuses, risktypes, riskimpacts, riskprobabilities, issuestatuses, issuetypes, purchasestatuses, purchasetypes, revenuestatuses, assessments. Use "assessments" to discover valid assessmentId values for create_task_progress. Some risk/issue reference data includes BaseId; write tools accept either Id or BaseId and normalize when v2 REST requires BaseId.

entity.description: The reference data entity to retrieve

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a project. Waterfall projects require StatusId, StartDate, and EndDate; Kanban projects use board defaults and do not require dates. Returns the created task read back from v2 REST (source of truth). Use get_reference_data with entity "gettaskstatuses", "gettasktypes", or "gettaskpriorities" to discover valid Waterfall IDs.

projectId.description: The project ID to create the task in

Description.description: Task description. Compatibility alias for the v2 REST Details field.

Details.description: Task details/description field used by v2 REST

StatusId.description: Task status ID. Required for Waterfall projects; Kanban uses board-specific status defaults.

StartDate.description: Start date (ISO 8601). Required for Waterfall projects.

EndDate.description: End date (ISO 8601). Required for Waterfall projects.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update task fields via PATCH. Only send the fields you want to change. Returns the updated task read back from v2 REST.

projectId.description: The project ID containing the task

Description.description: New description. Compatibility alias for the v2 REST Details field.

Details.description: New task details/description field used by v2 REST

tools.name: create_risk
tools.description: Log a new risk in a project. Returns the created risk read back from v2 REST. Use get_reference_data with entity "riskstatuses", "risktypes", "riskimpacts", or "riskprobabilities" to discover IDs; the tool accepts localized Id values and normalizes them to BaseId values where v2 REST requires them.

projectId.description: The project ID to create the risk in

LevelId.description: Risk level base ID required by v2 REST. No v2 risklevels reference endpoint currently exists.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Log a new issue in a project. Returns the created issue read back from v2 REST. Use get_reference_data with entity "issuestatuses" or "issuetypes" to discover IDs; the tool accepts localized Id values and normalizes them to BaseId values where v2 REST requires them.

projectId.description: The project ID to create the issue in

StatusId.description: Issue status ID (required). Mapped to the v2 REST Status field.

TypeId.description: Issue type ID (required). Mapped to the v2 REST Type field.

Resolution.description: Resolution description. Mapped to the v2 REST FinalResolution field.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project fields via PATCH. Only send the fields you want to change. Returns the updated project read back from v2 REST.

StatusId.description: New project status ID. Compatibility alias mapped to ProjectStatusId before calling v2 REST.

ProjectStatusId.description: New project status ID field used by v2 REST
